story.title: How we got here
story.p1: Musnad Tech was founded in Riyadh in 2021 by a small group of senior engineers who had spent a decade building software at scale — and who were tired of the gap between what teams promise and what actually ships. We started the studio to do software engineering the way we believed it should be done: rigorous, honest, and accountable to outcomes you can verify.
story.p2: From the first commit, we made a deliberate choice: bilingual-first, by default. Arabic and English are not translations bolted on at the end — they are first-class in our interfaces, our documentation, and our process. That same instinct shapes everything we ship. We publish case studies with real metrics, write RFCs for the hard decisions, open-source the tools we depend on, and stay honest about what worked and what didn't. Proof over claims is not a tagline; it is how we operate.

intro.title:
Frequently
asked questions
intro.subtitle: Quick answers about working with Musnad Tech. Can't find what you need? Contact us.

q1.question: How does Musnad Tech engage with clients?
q1.answer: We work on an outcome-focused basis. Every engagement starts with a technical discovery and scoping phase to align on architecture, milestones, and success metrics before committing to build. We then work with clear cadence, transparent communication, weekly demos, and end-to-end engineering accountability through launch and initial operations.

q2.question: Do you work with startups or only enterprises?
q2.answer: We work with both venture-backed startups and established enterprises. What matters most is strong technical ambition, problem complexity, and shared alignment on rigorous engineering standards and accountable delivery.

q1.question: Where is Musnad Tech based?
q1.answer: Musnad Tech is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, serving clients across the Kingdom and GCC, with seamless remote collaboration capabilities for regional and international engagements.

q2.question: Is your work open source?
q2.answer: We actively open-source selected internal tools, developer utilities, and research experiments to give back to the engineering community. Client code, proprietary systems, and business logic remain strictly confidential and protected under NDA.

q1.question: Do I need an account to browse or contact you?
q1.answer: No. You can browse our case studies, services, articles, and submit inquiries without an account. Accounts are completely optional and only needed if you wish to save projects, rate case studies, or leave comments.

q1.question: What happens after I submit an inquiry?
q1.answer: Our engineering leadership reviews every submission. Within two business days, we will get in touch to discuss technical scope, clarify details, and schedule an initial discovery session if there is a mutual fit.

stillHaveQuestions.title: Still have questions?
stillHaveQuestions.description: We're here to help. Send us an inquiry and our team will be in touch within two business days.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy policy
privacyPolicy.introNote: This policy explains what information Musnad Tech collects, how we use it, and the choices you have. It applies to this website and any inquiry or account you create.

s01.title: Information we collect
s01.p1: We collect only the information you choose to provide. When you submit an inquiry form, we receive your name, email, and the message you send — along with optional fields such as company, phone, budget, and timeline. If you attach a file, we keep the file for review and security scanning.
s01.p2: If you create an account, we store your display name, email, an optional profile (company, role, bio, phone), and your activity: saved projects, ratings, comments, and inquiries. Passwords are never stored in plain text.

s02.title: How we use information
s02.b1: To respond to your inquiry and schedule a follow-up.
s02.b2: To operate your account and the features tied to it (saved projects, ratings, comments).
s02.b3: To improve the website and our content. Analytics are aggregated and do not include personally identifiable information (PII).
s02.b4: To detect and prevent fraud, abuse, and security incidents.

s03.title: Cookies and analytics
s03.p1: We use a minimal set of cookies and local storage entries for locale, theme, and signed-in session. Analytics are aggregated only — we do not record IP addresses in association with PII. See our cookie policy for the full breakdown.

s04.title: Attachments and scanning
s04.p1: Files attached to project inquiries are scanned for malware before review. We retain attachments for up to 30 days after a conversation closes, then delete them unless a longer retention is required by law.

s05.title: Data retention
s05.b1: Inquiry data: retained for 12 months, then anonymized.
s05.b2: Account data: retained until you request deletion.
s05.b3: Comments and ratings: tied to your account and removed on deletion unless required for integrity of discussions.

s06.title: Your rights
s06.p1: You may access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data. To delete your account and personal data, use the 'Delete account' action under Account & Security, or contact us at hello@musnad.tech.

s07.title: Contact
s07.p1: For any privacy question, email hello@musnad.tech. We respond within two business days.

cookiePolicy.metaDescription: Learn how Musnad Tech uses cookies and local storage to provide preferences, sessions, and aggregated analytics.
cookiePolicy.title: Cookie policy
cookiePolicy.introNote: This policy explains how Musnad Tech uses cookies and local storage, and how you can control them.

s01.title: What are cookies
s01.p1: Cookies are small text files stored on your device by your browser. They allow a website to remember things like your language, theme, and signed-in state across page loads. Local storage serves a similar purpose for slightly larger or longer-lived data.

s02.title: Types we use
s02.b1: Essential: locale (Arabic/English), theme (light/dark), and signed-in session. The site does not function correctly without these.
s02.b2: Preference: saved projects and ratings you set are stored locally so they persist across visits.
s02.b3: Analytics: aggregated, anonymized usage data. No PII is collected or correlated with these.

s03.title: Third-party cookies
s03.p1: We do not sell data, and we do not embed advertising networks. If we add a third-party analytics or support tool in the future, we will name it here and apply a strict PII-free configuration.

s04.title: Managing and disabling cookies
s04.p1: Most browsers let you review and delete cookies from their settings. Disabling essential cookies means locale, theme, and sign-in will not persist between visits. Preference storage (saved projects, ratings) will reset.

s05.title: Impact on features
s05.b1: Without essential cookies: language and theme reset on each visit; sign-in does not persist.
s05.b2: Without preference storage: saved projects and ratings cannot persist locally.
s05.b3: Without analytics: site functionality is unaffected — you simply help us less in improving it.

s06.title: Changes to this policy
s06.p1: If we change the cookies we use, we will update this policy and revise the 'Last updated' date above.
